reason: The cited evidence does not support the key premises. E1 shows SRO destruction, not induction, and links SRO loss to ductility in CrCoNi, not CoCrFeMnNi. E2 discusses deformation-induced stacking faults and phase transformation in a dual-phase HEA, not a post-deformation heat treatment to enhance faults in a single-phase alloy. Neither passage provides evidence for the proposed heat treatment effects or the specific mechanism in dynamic loading.
premises: Post-deformation heat treatment can selectively enhance nanoscale stacking fault density in CoCrFeMnNi
Post-deformation heat treatment can induce short-range order (SRO) in CoCrFeMnNi
Enhanced stacking faults and SRO impede shear band propagation during dynamic loading
Impeded shear bands lead to homogeneous deformation and enhanced ductility without strength loss
